tasks.title: Add median tests to tests/stats.test.mjs
tasks.intent: Extend tests/stats.test.mjs (existing mean test untouched) with median cases: odd-length input returns the middle value ([3,1,2] → 2), even-length input returns the mean of the two middle values ([4,1,3,2] → 2.5), unsorted input, single element, and a non-mutation check that the input array is unchanged. lib/stats.mjs is deliberately not a write target so TST-C01 cannot be violated.

tasks.title: Run suite and grep acceptance
tasks.intent: Execute TST-001-A (grep -rq "median" tests, exit 0) and TST-C01-A (node --test "tests/*.test.mjs", exit 0) so both must properties have an executed verification path against the unmodified lib/.

observations.statement: tests/stats.test.mjs currently covers only mean; median copies, numerically sorts, and returns the middle element (odd) or the average of the two middle elements (even), so both shapes need coverage for TST-001.
TST-C01 requires lib/ unmodified; the plan's only write target is tests/stats.test.mjs, which structurally enforces the constraint.
